sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Elise is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is the receptionist in charge of handling Raid Battle requests from the Akras Summoners' Hall. Elise is a former Summoner and Vice-Commander of the 21st Division of the Demon Slayers, "Silver Knights" whom Noah is the commander of it.

sections.title: History
sections.content: Elise appears in Hopes and Regrets as one of the main characters in the said Grand Quest. She was on her day off from work and decided to go on a camping with her friends Lin and Sera. Throughout the Grand Quest, Elise tells the two girls on how she became a Summoner and her possible relationship with her childhood friend Noah. It was later revealed that she stripped herself from being a Summoner after a certain curse struck her, making her unable to fight.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: Elise has a cheerful personality. She often worries for Noah even more while nevertheless she is still a very caring person.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Elise's age when she was first introduced was 23 years old.
- According to Brave Frontier Storybook:
- Her full name is Elise Vedel.
- Her birth date is October 26.
- Her height is 163 cm.
- Her weight is 45 kg.
- Her 3-size is 86/61/83 (in cm).
- Two of her hobbies are rock climbing and surfing.
